caption: The drawing depicts five human figures arranged in an outdoor setting with trees and foliage in the background. Two seated figures are positioned at the center; both wear light-colored clothing with hints of pink and white, and head coverings. On the left, a standing person in a pale pink dress with voluminous sleeves and ruffles, and a large hat decorated with white and blue, faces the group. To the right, a figure wearing a brown coat and tall hat stands next to another individual in a similar pink dress and elaborate hat as the figure on the left. The background features dark green and red foliage against a blue sky, and the ground is painted in light blue, with the suggestion of water or a reflective surface beneath the figures. There is a vertical rock or monument shape behind the central seated figures. The composition is framed by a rectangular border, and the name “ISABELLA.RUTH.DOERFLER” is typed in the lower right corner of the cream-colored margin. The illustration uses thick, expressive brush strokes and a color palette dominated by blue, pink, brown, green, and some white highlights.
title: Bandbox Design
